
---
title: "Cross-Species Fibroblast Clustering Analysis"
author: "Gauri Agrawal"
date: "2025-12-25"
output: html_document
---

```{r full-analysis, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries

library(Biobase)
library(fibroEset)
library(ggplot2)


## 1. Load Data and Sample Annotations

data("fibroEset")                       # Load fibroblast expression dataset
expr_data <- exprs(fibroEset)           # Extract expression matrix (genes x samples)
sample_info <- pData(fibroEset)         # Extract sample annotations
classification <- sample_info$species   # Species labels for each sample


## 2. Subset a Random Set of Genes

set.seed(123)
random_genes <- sample(rownames(expr_data), 50)     # Randomly select 50 genes
expr_subset <- expr_data[random_genes, ]            # Subset expression matrix


## 3. Hierarchical Clustering of Samples

# Compute Manhattan distance between samples
dist_manhattan <- dist(t(expr_subset), method = "manhattan")

# Perform hierarchical clustering
hc <- hclust(dist_manhattan, method = "median")

# Plot dendrogram with species labels
plot(hc,
labels = classification,
main = "Hierarchical Clustering of Fibroblast Samples",
xlab = "Species",
sub = "",
cex = 0.8)



## 4. Heatmap with Joint Clustering of Genes and Samples

# Scale genes (rows) to emphasize relative expression
expr_scaled <- t(scale(t(expr_subset)))

# Plot heatmap with hierarchical clustering
heatmap(expr_scaled,
distfun = function(x) dist(x, method = "manhattan"),
hclustfun = function(x) hclust(x, method = "median"),
labRow = rownames(expr_scaled),
labCol = classification,
main = "Hierarchical Clustering Heatmap",
margins = c(8, 8))



## 5. PCA and Spectral K-means Clustering

# Perform PCA on samples
pca_res <- prcomp(t(expr_subset), scale. = TRUE)

# Extract first two principal components
pc_data <- pca_res$x[, 1:2]

# K-means clustering on PCA space
set.seed(123)
kmeans_res <- kmeans(pc_data, centers = 3)



## 6. PCA Visualization with Cluster Membership

cluster_colors <- c("red", "blue", "green")
sample_colors <- cluster_colors[kmeans_res$cluster]

# Plot PCA embedding
plot(pc_data[,1], pc_data[,2],
col = sample_colors,
pch = 19,
xlab = "PC1",
ylab = "PC2",
main = "PCA of Fibroblast Samples with K-means Clusters")

# Add sample labels
text(pc_data[,1], pc_data[,2],
labels = classification,
pos = 3,
cex = 0.7)

# Add legend
legend("topright",
legend = paste("Cluster", 1:3),
col = cluster_colors,
pch = 19,
bty = "n")

```
